THREE-ROUND FORMAT

THE ROAD TO THE FINAL

Each round is a separate multiplayer race. Place higher to earn more points. Complete all three rounds to unlock the series completion reward.

Scoring: 1st 10 pts · 2nd 7 pts · 3rd 5 pts · 4th 3 pts · 5th 2 pts · 6th 1 pt. The online lobby requires at least two human racers.

Ranked uses the online queue. After 18 seconds, AI racers matched to the lobby’s Street Rep level and car performance fill any open grid slots.

Each Ranked race costs one Ranked Ticket and 5 energy. Ranked Tickets are separate from Credits and are consumed only after a valid opponent is found.

ONLINE HEAD-TO-HEAD
